findings.location:
Last paragraph of third

(printing history) — sentence: "L’impression a parcouru un long chemin depuis 1436, lorsque chaque page devait être composées et imprimée individuellement."
findings.source_quote: "...when each page had to be set up and printed individually."
findings.suggested_fix: Correct grammatical agreement: change "devait être composées" to "devait être composée" so the past passive participle agrees with "page" (singular, feminine).
findings.translation_quote: "L’impression a parcouru un long chemin depuis 1436, lorsque chaque page devait être composées et imprimée individuellement."

findings.location: Penultimate paragraph — article titles left in English (quoted substantive prose)
findings.source_quote: "A Glorious Church by Barry Grant and Joy in the Crevices by Sheryl Zeiset were both first printed in 2019."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the article titles into French (quoted substantive prose must be rendered in the target language). Preserve the authors and year and the surrounding sentence structure. Example: replace "A Glorious Church de Barry Grant et Joy in the Crevices de Sheryl Zeiset" with a faithful French rendering of the titles, e.g. "Un Église glorieuse de Barry Grant et Joie dans les crevasses de Sheryl Zeiset" (or another translator-approved wording), and keep the rest of the sentence unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: "A Glorious Church de Barry Grant et Joy in the Crevices de Sheryl Zeiset ont tous deux été publiés pour la première fois en 2019."

findings.location: Third paragraph (periodical name) — magazine title left in English inside body text
findings.source_quote: "...it is much easier to print a periodical magazine such as The Heartbeat of the Remnant."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the magazine title or present it in a French typographic form consistent with the rest of the translation. Quoted or translatable article metadata appearing in the article body should be rendered into the target language. For example: replace "The Heartbeat of the Remnant" with a French rendering such as "Le Battement du Reste" (or another approved translation of the publication title), or keep the original title but indicate it as a proper name in French punctuation if the style guide requires. Preserve the surrounding sentence.
findings.translation_quote: "...il est beaucoup plus facile d’imprimer un périodique comme The Heartbeat of the Remnant."
